evals.prompt: Put our 15-step release process into the Excalidraw Canvas in my HiGantic workspace. Use five stages, show approval decisions, and keep rollback/rework arrows from tangling with the main path.
evals.expected_output: Creates or reuses a HiGantic Canvas page, submits a semantic flowchart with stable IDs and labeled feedback paths, and reports persisted validation and identifiers.
assertions: Lists existing Canvas pages before deciding whether to create one.
Uses semantic flowchart input with stable node IDs, five named stages, decision shapes, and labeled rollback or rework edges rather than hand-authored coordinates.
Reports returned page and scene identifiers, scene version, renderer, and persisted geometry validation instead of claiming success from the input alone.

evals.prompt: Update the existing HiGantic architecture canvas scene SCENE_ID on page PAGE_ID from architecture.excalidraw, but don't overwrite anybody else's newer changes.
evals.expected_output: Reads the current scene, uses its returned version as the replacement precondition, handles conflicts without blind overwrite, and reports the new version.
assertions: Reads the exact existing scene before attempting replacement.
Uses the returned current version as expectedVersion on replacement.
Treats a scene_version_conflict as a reread-and-reconcile condition and never retries blindly.

evals.prompt: Delete the old draft Canvas scene from my HiGantic agent.
evals.expected_output: Treats deletion as destructive, confirms exact intent and target, reads the latest version, and deletes only with explicit confirmation and the version precondition.
assertions: Does not delete until the exact scene target and destructive intent are confirmed.
Reads the target scene immediately before deletion and uses its current version.
Sends the explicit delete confirmation and optimistic version precondition; it does not suggest page deletion.
